# A minute-by-minute wedding day timeline, with the sunset worked out

> Free wedding day timeline builder. Enter your date, city, ceremony time and guest count and get a minute-by-minute schedule: hair and makeup, first look, portraits, ceremony, cocktail hour, dinner, toasts and dancing, with sunset portraits placed at golden hour. Separate views for each vendor.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [How long wedding photos take, with a worked timeline](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/wedding-day-timeline-builder/wedding-photography-timeline.html)
